additional_concerns: The formula answers only whether an applicable paragraph 14 demonstration request exists for an in-scope provider. TRUE does not establish performance, SFC satisfaction, or compliance; FALSE does not extinguish confirmation or underlying duties. The TRUE_IS_SATISFIED label must retain this trigger-only meaning.
The request-conditioned reading is expressly assumed by the question. Footnote 5's unqualified wording supports a rival reading that remains unresolved; the formula does not adjudicate it.

No actual scope or request facts are supplied. Both classifications require independent evidence, including the request's subject, recipient, arrangement and timing. Missing evidence must remain UNKNOWN.

Complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and the referenced Appendix factors are absent. They matter to a broader substantive compliance assessment but do not establish an additional condition for this narrowly specified request trigger. The reach of the high-confidence qualification also remains unresolved.
Paragraph 16 concerns a separate request for a satisfactory legal opinion. Neither it nor paragraph 15 is automatically activated by a paragraph 14 demonstration request.
The supplied structural and retrieval checks establish neither legal applicability nor factual activation. No unsupported extra restriction or permission is apparent in the narrow trigger expression.
